scope: source-level ABI and caller review only; runtime, ownership and threading admission remain separate gates

findings.decision: record the two removals and defer the four new functions and callback type as a subsystem

findings.evidence: ops.cpp forwards global_scale.ctx as an optional array; the existing Rust wrapper passes its owned absent handle, preserving the previous no-global-scale behavior
findings.decision: compatibility rebind without public API changes
